component.name: HomeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.rowList = m.top.findNode("rowList") m.feedTask = m.top.findNode("feedTask")
' Focus shelves m.rowList.setFocus(true)
' Watch feed results m.feedTask.observeField("response", "onFeedResponse") m.feedTask.observeField("error", "onFeedError")
' Start feed load m.feedTask.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onFeedError() err = m.feedTask.error if err <> invalid and err <> "" then print "FEED ERROR: "; err end if end sub
sub onFeedResponse() jsonStr = m.feedTask.response if jsonStr = invalid or jsonStr = "" then return
data = ParseJson(jsonStr) if data = invalid then print "FEED ERROR: JSON parse failed" return end if
contentRoot = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode")
if data.categories <> invalid for each cat in data.categories rowNode = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") rowNode.title = cat.title
if cat.items <> invalid for each it in cat.items itemNode = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode")
' Common fields Roku UI components tend to use itemNode.title = it.title itemNode.shortDescriptionLine1 = it.shortDescription itemNode.description = it.description
' Posters itemNode.hdPosterUrl = it.poster itemNode.sdPosterUrl = it.poster itemNode.poster = it.poster itemNode.thumbnail = it.poster itemNode.fhdPosterUrl = it.poster
' Playback fields (used by many PlayerScene patterns) itemNode.url = it.videoUrl itemNode.streamFormat = it.videoType
if it.duration <> invalid then itemNode.length = it.duration
rowNode.appendChild(itemNode) end for end if
contentRoot.appendChild(rowNode) end for end if
m.rowList.content = contentRoot end sub
